risks.title: Financial market volatility
risks.score_rationale: Ameriprise's revenues and earnings are highly exposed to financial market fluctuations and interest rate changes. The 10-K indicates that asset management fees, variable life insurance product values, and spread revenues are sensitive to market movements.

risks.title: Intensified competition
risks.score_rationale: Ameriprise operates in a highly competitive financial services sector. Retaining financial advisors and clients amid increasing competition represents a major strategic challenge.

risks.title: Credit and counterparty risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to credit risk through its asset management activities, investments, and contracts with policyholders. The 10-K explicitly mentions exposures to counterparties with credit risk.

risks.title: Complex and evolving regulatory environment
risks.score_rationale: Ameriprise is subject to complex and continuously changing federal and state regulations. The report highlights that the business and regulatory environment are subject to high uncertainty and frequent changes.

risks.title: Dependence on technological infrastructure
risks.score_rationale: Ameriprise relies heavily on an integrated technology platform to support its advisors and serve clients. Technological failures or cybersecurity issues could disrupt operations.

ai_positioning.summary: Ameriprise Financial does not significantly mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in the analyzed sections of the 10-K. No major AI initiatives were identified in the available text.
